name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Ruby 4.0 Universal RCE Deserialization Gadget Chain
items.dek: Universal Ruby deserialization gadget chain enables RCE; requires immediate review if Ruby is in the SDLC dependency tree.
items.unproven: depends on whether reader's codebase uses vulnerable deserialization patterns; exploitation conditions not yet confirmed in production environments

items.title: LLM-Assisted Dynamic Threat Analysis for Attacker-Reachable Software Weaknesses in Autonomous Vehicles
items.dek: LLMs generate 3,700 test harnesses for safety-critical weaknesses in Autoware; 64% compile first-attempt, 80% failures are dependency wiring.
items.unproven: One codebase (Autoware), no evidence that generated harnesses find exploitable vulnerabilities missed by existing SAST or fuzzing pipelines.

items.title: For the love of god stop using CPU limits in Kubernetes
items.dek: Kubernetes CPU limits often misconfig and harm stability; informs platform hardening this quarter if reader runs K8s.
items.unproven: scoped to CPU limits only; does not cover memory, I/O, or network resource controls

items.title: Person Hides Prompt Injection in Legal Filing Telling AI to Side with Them
items.dek: Prompt injection embedded in legal document demonstrates an attack surface in LLM-assisted review workflows.
items.unproven: whether production legal AI systems lack defenses against this; applicability to agents in SDLC pipelines

items.title: Experimental Quantum Key Distribution in an Indefinite Causal Order
items.dek: Photonic quantum BB84 variant using indefinite causal order detects eavesdropping without disclosing key material.
items.unproven: lab-scale proof-of-concept only; post-quantum cryptography and quantum key distribution are outside reader's security-SDLC remit

items.title: Exponential quantum advantage for learning signals with a single qubit
items.dek: Single-qubit coupling to classical sensors achieves 10⁷-fold measurement reduction for signal learning.
items.unproven: Scalability beyond proof-of-concept demonstrations; generalization to real dark-matter and wireless systems.

items.title: Strong unitary designs in optimal depth and space
items.dek: Strong unitary designs achievable in logarithmic depth using only system qubits.
items.unproven: Experimental demonstration on real quantum hardware; overhead constants and noise resilience.

items.title: Terabytes of credentials leaked in supply-chain attack
items.dek: Supply-chain credential breach reported; scope and affected systems unclear from headline.
items.unproven: which systems or dependencies the reader's firm actually uses; whether credentials are active or rotated

items.title: Every PPT channel has finite entanglement-breaking index
items.dek: Proves PPT channels have finite entanglement-breaking index; advances quantum information theory.
items.unproven: pure mathematical result; entirely outside application security remit

items.title: Clifford Circuit Synthesis for Distributed Quantum Architectures with Arbitrary Network Topology
items.dek: Synthesis method for distributed quantum Clifford circuits minimizes inter-block operations.
items.unproven: purely theoretical; no practical quantum computing deployment relevant to reader

items.title: Quantum simulation of non-Markovian dynamical systems
items.dek: Quantum algorithms for non-Markovian Volterra integro-differential equations achieve exponential speedup over classical methods.
items.unproven: quantum computing research with no connection to application security or SDLC

items.title: Inductively-protected Andreev (IPA) spin qubit
items.authors: J. L. del Olmo N. et al.
items.dek: Inductor-shunted Andreev spin qubit extends coherence by separating spin states in phase space.
items.unproven: Device fabrication challenges, scaling to multi-qubit systems, and integration with existing quantum processors.

items.title: Ambient unitaries don't enable shallow group designs
items.dek: Local shallow circuits cannot form approximate unitary designs even with ambient unitaries.
items.unproven: Practical implications for near-term quantum device benchmarking remain unclear.

items.title: Concept Drift Detection and Adaptive Retraining of Malware Classification Models
items.authors: Christofer Washington Berruz Chungata et al.
items.dek: Compares drift detection methods (OCSVM, K-Means, MMD) on malware classifiers across four model families.
items.unproven: Single malware dataset, no evidence that drift detection timing improves real classifier maintenance or deployment decisions.

items.title: Aperiodicity is sufficient for macroscopic thermalization
items.dek: Aperiodicity in quantum dynamics drives macroscopic thermalization independent of microscopic details.
items.unproven: Connection to experimentally measurable equilibration timescales; applicability to open systems.

items.title: Spectral Localization Principle for Entanglement Harvesting
items.dek: Entanglement harvesting from quantum fields determined by spectral density localization.
items.unproven: Extension beyond single-cavity model; experimental realization in realistic field geometries.

items.title: Going Dark, and the era of law enforcement hacking
items.dek: Essay on law enforcement encryption workarounds and device access; rehashes known debates without new technical findings.
items.unproven: entirely outside reader's remit; concerns policy and law enforcement capability, not application security engineering or SDLC

items.title: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
items.dek: Google applies homomorphic encryption to inference; practical deployment timeline and performance overhead remain undisclosed.
items.unproven: production viability, latency and cost at scale, whether constraints apply to the reader's AI agent use cases in SDLC

items.title: Quantum correlations and Basis-Independent Coherence Distribution in Two Gravitational Cat States
items.dek: Basis-independent coherence measure applied to gravitationally coupled two-particle double-well system.
items.unproven: Experimental validation and applicability to systems beyond this specific model.

items.title: Show HN: Laptop is the last place your secrets are still in plaintext
items.dek: Tool to encrypt secrets on developer machines; plaintext storage risk is known.
items.unproven: whether adoption solves the actual secret-sprawl problem or moves it to key management

items.title: Europe's scorched landscapes seen from space after summer heatwaves
items.dek: Satellite imagery of European heat damage; climate reporting outside security scope.
